description: Two errors in Systemic Compliance prep sheet: (1) Included Devlin references throughout despite David running solo — 'If stuck, bring Devlin in' is unhelpful when he's not there. (2) Treated Robin Graham as an unknown stakeholder with TBD influence when she is Kevin's wife — attending as family/support, not a primary decision driver.

corrections.reported: Multiple fallback lines referencing Devlin for technical depth
corrections.correct: Remove entirely — David owns the technical conversation solo

corrections.reported: Unknown stakeholder, TBD title, potentially the decision-maker
corrections.correct: Kevin's wife — may attend, not driving the meeting

proposed_fix: Never surface fallback references to absent people in prep sheets. When attendee identity is unclear, ask before building rather than speculating.
